description: This file defines the LogicalNode class, which represents logical nodes such as AND, OR, and NOT in a predicate abstract syntax tree (AST). It includes various constructors, accessors, and a nested enum for node types.

classes.name: LogicalNode
classes.description: Represents a logical node (AND, OR, NOT) in an abstract syntax tree, with associated type and name, and children nodes.

classes.name: LogicalNode.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of possible logical node types: AND, OR, NOT.

methods.name: LogicalNode(final String name)
methods.description: Constructs a logical node with a given name, inferring type from name.

methods.name: LogicalNode(final Type type)
methods.description: Constructs a logical node with a specific type.

methods.name: LogicalNode(final Type type, final Node... subNodes)
methods.description: Constructs a logical node with a type and varargs children nodes.

methods.name: LogicalNode(final Type type, final Collection<Node> subNodes)
methods.description: Constructs a logical node with a type and a collection of children nodes.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the name of this logical node.

methods.name: getType()
methods.description: Returns the type (AND, OR, NOT) of this logical node.

methods.name: accept(final PredicateVisitor predicateVisitor)
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this logical node.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the logical node, including name, type, and children.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the logical node object.

methods.name: equals(final Object obj)
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.
